name: Geneburn Music Pack
teaser: Nikita music is a rare W
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds all of Geneburn’s Music including music from his soundcloud and Arena song ie Encircled to SPT. This is a tribute to the music mod that used to add Geneburn’s music on older versions. Credit goes to Nikita/Geneburn etc

Install instructions: Drag BepinEx Folder into SPT Directory. Mod uses Bobby’s Music Replacer for Menu. It will get an In raid version.

https://youtu.be/Q3rL0wSFfEM?si=YOte1jqc_0YkrVqJ Preview

Updated to SPT 3.10.X
